description: Public list prices for charging in Turkey, by operator, in TRY per kWh with VAT included. A dated snapshot, curated by hand. A range [min, max] means the operator publishes a band and the price varies by station location and/or start hour. Under the 2026 rules the band's upper end is the list price and lower prices are location or time discounts.

verification_levels.operator: read on the operator's own public price page on the access date
verification_levels.press: NOT confirmed on the operator page (page blocked, rate-limited, JavaScript-only or disallowing automated access); value from a dated national newspaper article. Treat as indicative.
verification_levels.unknown: no operator or reliable source found; do not use a number

regulation.title: Şarj Hizmeti Yönetmeliğinde Değişiklik Yapılmasına Dair Yönetmelik (EPDK)
rules: the price is set freely and charged per kWh delivered; no connection, start or equipment fee of any kind
public stations: prices may differ ONLY between AC units, DC units and mobile stations ('tek tarife'), so no tiers by charger power and no state-of-charge tiers
discounts are allowed by station location and by time of day; with time-of-day pricing, the price of the hour in which the session STARTS applies
the public price may not exceed 1.25 x the lowest price the operator gives to users with a loyalty contract
with prior notice, an operator may end a DC session once the battery reaches 85 % SoC

operators must publish prices on their website, in their apps and at the station, and report them to EPDK; EPDK's free-access platform Şarj@TR shows the location, sockets, power, availability and price of every public station

Trugo.note: DC price varies by location within the band; the site advertises a 20 % DC discount for Togg owners

ZES.note: DC-1 / DC-2 band, 'prices may vary by location'; idle fee 150/300/450/500 TRY after 15/30/45/60 min

Eşarj.note: the official page https://esarj.com/fiyatlandirma loads prices in-app/by JavaScript, and its robots.txt disallows automated access, so the price was not read there. Aggregators list DC 9.90-14.90 in Oct 2026 (unverified).

WAT Mobilite.note: price varies by location within the band

Tesla.note: Supercharger prices are shown per site in the Tesla app; tesla.com returned HTTP 403. Not verified.

En Yakıt.note: DC-only network; 10.90 at listed campaign stations (campaign 20-31 Oct 2026 according to press)

Voltrun.note: voltrun.com answered HTTP 429 (rate limited) on every attempt

Zeplin.note: operator site unreachable (proxy 502); only unsourced aggregator values found

Otopriz.note: the operator site disallows AI agents in robots.txt, so it was not used

Shell Recharge.note: the press quoted two DC prices by power (<=60 / <=180 kW), which the March 2026 rule no longer allows at public stations; probably outdated

Otojet.note: operator site failed TLS host-name verification; no reliable source

Neva Şarj.note: AC up to 22 kW, DC up to 240 kW; idle fee 10 TRY/min after 15 min (max 1,000)

Aksa Şarj.note: the price varies by station, unit type AND start hour within the band (time-of-day pricing)

K-Şarj.note: operator site unreachable; only unsourced aggregator values found

Lumicle.note: operator site has a self-signed TLS certificate; not fetched

Sharz.net.note: the most-mapped operator in OSM Turkey (mostly AC at hotels and businesses); sharz.net returned HTTP 403; only aggregator values (AC 9.49 / DC 11.99, 10.08.2026), which are not verified

market_shares_epdk_sep_2026_consumption_.source: EPDK, Şarj Hizmeti Piyasası Aylık İstatistikleri - Eylül 2026 (top-20 brands by electricity consumed)

suggested_defaults.basis: median of the operator-verified list prices (upper end of each band) on 2026-10-27: AC 9.99 (n=9: Trugo, ZES, WAT, Astor, Oncharge, Neva, Efish, Aksa, Beefull), DC 14.24 (n=10, the same operators plus En Yakıt; middle values 13.99 and 14.49). Weighted by the operators' EPDK Sept 2026 consumption shares, the upper-end DC price is ~15.2, because Trugo (14.98) and ZES (16.49) dominate.
suggested_defaults.use: for stations whose operator is unknown or unverified; keep the operator price where it is verified
